name: Google Search Console
note: Search analytics, sitemap status and indexed-URL inspection. Average position is not a fixed rank; top-row coverage is bounded.

name: WordPress
note: Pages and posts; registered REST meta fields only. Configure SEO plugin field mappings explicitly. Published content keeps its status.

name: WooCommerce
note: Product names, descriptions and short descriptions. Prices, inventory and reviews are never changed.

name: Shopify
note: Product SEO title and description via versioned GraphQL. Theme edits and theme publication are not part of this connector.

name: Webflow
note: Static-page SEO metadata and mapped CMS fields. Changes are staged; publishing the whole site is not automatic.

name: Google Analytics 4
note: Landing-page sessions, engagement, key events and revenue. Attribution depends on the property's tracking setup.

name: Vercel
note: Deployment status and signed events. Only the configured production origin and environment can trigger verification.

name: Netlify
note: Deployment status. Use the signed generic deployment event from CI for a consistent verification payload.

name: Other hosting / CI
note: Signed deployment events from any host; replay, origin, freshness and environment checks enforced.

name: GitLab
note: File reads, guarded branch commits and merge requests on GitLab.com. Self-hosted endpoints require a separately reviewed host configuration.

name: Bitbucket
note: File reads, guarded branch commits and pull requests on Bitbucket Cloud. Existing PR lifecycle must be completed in Bitbucket.

name: Bing Webmaster Tools
note: Query statistics and crawl statistics. AI citation dashboard ingestion is not claimed without a documented accessible API.

name: Google Business Profile
note: Read business details and update regular hours from unexpired trusted project facts. Google API approval is required.

name: Cloudflare
note: Sampled request analytics, paths and response statuses. Dataset availability depends on plan; visits do not establish citations or bot identity.

name: Server logs
note: Import bounded structured request records. User agents are self-reported; no user IPs or cookies are stored.

name: Wix
note: Read site SEO tags plus live-page audits. Page-level writes are withheld until the relevant Wix page/app API can be validated; proposals can be exported.

name: Squarespace
note: Commerce product SEO metadata. General pages and blogs use live-page audits and exported recommendations; no general page-edit API is assumed.

name: Framer
note: Official Server API bridge for CMS reads and mapped CMS-field changes. Requires Node and the bundled framer-api bridge; no automatic production deployment.

name: Sanity
note: Mapped document fields with revision preconditions. Only existing draft documents are writable; publish through the customer's normal review flow.

name: Contentful
note: Mapped entry fields with version preconditions. Updates stay unpublished; publication is managed through Contentful.

name: Keyword & competitor rankings
note: Paid Google organic SERP observations by query, location and language. One bounded live task per explicit collection; charges are recorded when returned.

name: AI answer visibility
note: Search-enabled API experiments and separately labelled imports of consumer observations. Never presented as universal rankings or consumer-product coverage.
